definition: to be going to do something very soon
description: In an indoor swimming pool with tall sunlit windows, the view starts close on the bare feet and legs of a young woman standing on a diving board and pulls back to show her whole body. She has short bleached hair and a grey swimsuit. She bends her knees, swings her arms back, then straightens and spreads her arms, ready to jump, at the very end of the board. Wet footprints mark the board, and far below a coach in black and swimmers at the edge look up from the blue water with red and white lane ropes.

en.question: What is the diver about to do?

de.answer: Sie wird gleich ins Becken springen.
de.question: Was wird die Springerin gleich tun?

es.answer: Está a punto de tirarse a la piscina.
phrases: hacerle una señal a la saltadora

fr.answer: Elle s'apprête à plonger dans la piscine.
